title: 12 arcade machine models added to my free AI-made 3D library, which now has 1500+ models in 125 categories
author: vinishkapoor
selftext:
New category in my free 3D model library: 12 arcade machines. There's an upright cabinet, claw crane, pinball, air hockey, racing seat, dance machine, boxing machine, prize counter and more.

The claw and the punching bag are separate parts, so you can animate them. Screens and lights glow. All the screen art is original, with no real game names or logos.

This isn't the only new pack, either. The whole library now has over 1500 models in 125 categories.

GLB, glTF, OBJ and STL, CC BY 4.0, no sign-up.

Arcade pack: [https://vinish.dev/free-3d-models/arcade](https://vinish.dev/free-3d-models/arcade)
